notes.seeder_namespace: scripts/seed-pages.php emits <!-- wp:ai-zippy/{name} /-->, so ALL child blocks must register under the ai-zippy/ namespace (e.g. ai-zippy/home-hero) even though their source lives in src/wp-content/themes/ai-zippy-child/src/blocks/.
notes.shop: Woo resolves /shop/ to the product archive; the child override of templates/archive-product.html (and taxonomy-product_cat.html) renders ai-zippy/shop-catalog directly, so the page's post_content is not used.
notes.cart: Reuses the parent page-cart template (mounts the parent #ai-zippy-cart app); the child only re-skins it. Mockup has no standalone cart view — the drawer is the cart.
notes.checkout: The parent page-checkout template wraps [woocommerce_checkout]; the child must override templates/page-checkout.html to add the S.Mart heading and ai-zippy/checkout-fulfilment above the checkout form, and re-skin Woo checkout (zk__/wc-block classes) to match slim.html:648-791. The checkout-fulfilment block is placed by the template, not by page content.
notes.my_account: Reuses the parent page-account template; child re-skins only.
templates_to_create_in_child: templates/page-home.html (+ customTemplates entry in child theme.json)
notes.header_part: parts/header.html: colour strip (slim.html:17-24) + brand row (logo logo-smart.jpg 52px, S.MART wordmark with red text-stroke, tagline 'At Your Convenience', search pill, nav pills Home/Shop/About Us/Contact, ai-zippy/mini-cart button) + ai-zippy/delivery-bar. Sticky, z-30.
notes.footer_part: parts/footer.html: dark #111827 (slim.html:413-469) — brand column ('At your convenience. Operated by Profitrade.'), Explore nav links, Store column ('Daily 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM', '10 Example Road, #01-01', 'Singapore 000000'), 'We accept' PayNow/VISA/Mastercard chips, legal line '© 2026 Profitrade. S.Mart is a Profitrade brand.', bottom colour strip.
